text: This report recommends that the name "Bakery Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located north of Eastern Avenue, west of Logan Avenue and extending southerly from Louis Kesten Lane. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Bakery Lane" for an existing public lane located north of Eastern Avenue, west of Logan Avenue and extending southerly from Louis Kesten Lane.
